label: Bindi et al. (2010)
units: PGA, SA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (PGA, four branches (horizontal/vertical x Rjb/Repi)) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Bindi et al. (2010)

distance.note: RESOLVED: the appendix publishes SEPARATE coefficient sets for Rjb and for Repi, so this is a choice of coefficient set, not a fallback. Pick the set matching the distance you have; never convert between the two.

site.anchor_note: RESOLVED from Douglas (2011) section 2.280, following Sabetta & Pugliese (1987, 1996).

class_definitions.class_0: Rock; NEHRP A and B. Reference (C0 = 0).
class_definitions.class_1: Shallow sediment: deposits > 5 m and <= 20 m thick, sediment Vs < 800 m/s.
class_definitions.class_2: Deep sediment: deposits thicker than 20 m.

mechanism.anchor_note: The PGA anchor contains no mechanism term.

published_grid_summary.note: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table) gives the count and range only; no OpenQuake implementation and the paper is not openly available. Still RESOLVE.

coefficients.needed: The SPECTRAL period table for each of the four branches. All four PGA branches (a, b1, b2, c1, c2, h, C0-C2 and the sigma decomposition) are now available.

implementation_notes: Both horizontal and vertical data sit in the underlying dataset; keep the sets separate.
Test the Rjb/Repi selection path explicitly.

aleatory.note: Decomposed as event / station / total rather than inter / intra. A station term is not the same as phi; keep the published naming.

resolution_provenance.component: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component code L
